== frame first_fails cursor=5,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'exit 3' | cat
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $?
|0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

== frame last_fails cursor=10,20

|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $?
|0

|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo x | sh -c 'exit 4'

|4
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~

== frame both_fail cursor=15,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'exit 3' | cat
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $?
|0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo x | sh -c 'exit 4'
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $?
|4
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'exit 5' | sh -c 'exit 6'
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $?
|6
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
